<js>var s=String(result);var i=s.indexOf('{');var j=s.lastIndexOf('}')+1;var json=s.substring(i,j);var obj=JSON.parse(json);var cust=obj.customer_url;var vols=obj.bookVolumeList;var arr=[];for(var v=0;v<vols.length;v++){var chs=vols[v].bookChapterList;for(var c=0;c<chs.length;c++){arr.push({name:chs[c].chapter_name,url:'https://www.sobqg.com/read/'+cust+'/'+chs[c].id+'.html'});}}result=JSON.stringify(arr);</js>
